title: Add FIPS level callout to KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE documentation
description: In docs/programmers_guide.md KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE section: add a callout box noting that plaintext private key export is incompatible with FIPS 140-3 Level 2 and above, which requires keys to leave a module only in encrypted (key-wrapped) form per SP 800-38F. State that this interface targets FIPS 140-3 Level 1 only. If Level 2+ compliance is required, private keys must remain non-exportable (exportable=0) and be managed entirely within the kernel module. Also update DESIGN.md to record this decision.
